title: Choir and House
author: Paloma Vane
blurb: Theo Eriksen, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must return what was taken in 1974 before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
